words: Nick 2026-10-15: 'I just want the generated paw. The different percentages were supposed to be for what they had produced last to get it back to what was the generated paw. I don't need a smaller version of the generated paw. I only said smaller because what was created was larger than the generated paw.' Paws = the generated paws exactly, all four, no scaling, no claws or clefts added. My brief misread his first note as 'slimmer than generated'.
